note: Every trace is demo wiring over PMState/PMShell/PMProvider with concept_local_state:true - none of it may be mistaken for production wiring in the impact audit. Recovery deep links are real routes this build serves.

traces.validation_permission: Settings write; per-kind required fields; secret fields accept vault references only - a missing reference saves as needs-setup, a raw token is unrepresentable
traces.mutation_or_operation: Append destination {id, kind, label, state, config} to notifications.destinations
traces.receipt: Destination added (ready, or needs-setup naming the missing vault reference)
traces.ui_projection: New card on the destinations board; new column available in the routing matrix

traces.validation_permission: Destination must be ready (or validation-error, to prove the failure path); rate limit one per 30 seconds per destination
traces.mutation_or_operation: PMState.trigger('dest-test', destId): staged op sending -> done|failed|rate-limited; persists lastTest {when, ok, receiptId, masked:true}
traces.receipt: Destination test - delivered/failed, payload masked, receipt kept; delivered tests join the title-bar stack via PMShell.notify
traces.ui_projection: Phase strip on the card, then the refreshed lastTest line; title-bar count increments
traces.usage_attribution: delivery channel usage only (no model usage)

traces.validation_permission: Settings write; mode must be one of always/when-unfocused/failures-only/never
traces.receipt: statusbar confirmation naming event, destination, and mode
traces.ui_projection: The select cell itself; run.failed keeps its sound-never-sole-signal note row

traces.canonical_owner: Plans/FinalGUISpec.md (sounds) + Release owner for asset provenance
traces.validation_permission: File must pass format, duration, and hash checks before any library mutation
traces.mutation_or_operation: PMState.trigger('sound-upload'): staged checking -> done; appends gentle-bell.ogg with provenance to sounds.library
traces.receipt: Sound uploaded - checked (format, duration, hash) and added to the library
traces.ui_projection: New asset row in the table with source Upload and its uploadedAt

traces.canonical_owner: Plans/FinalGUISpec.md (sounds) + Release owner (unverified packs are never bundled or enabled)
traces.validation_permission: Two gates in order: format check, then license check; either failure is a receipted terminal state
traces.mutation_or_operation: PMState.trigger('pack-import', packId): format-check -> license-check -> done|blocked|rejected; only done mutates pack.state to imported
traces.receipt: Import blocked (OpenPeon Vol. 2: no verifiable license) / Pack rejected (warcraft-rip.zip: manifest missing, non-audio files) / Pack imported
traces.ui_projection: Phase strip on the pack card; state word and check details persist on the card

traces.validation_permission: TOML must validate against theme schema 1.2; an invalid file NEVER half-applies
traces.mutation_or_operation: PMState.trigger('theme-reload', themeId): validating -> done (lastLoaded updates) | invalid (errors kept, base theme stays in effect)
traces.receipt: Theme still invalid - line 41: Expected a color, got "#3G4A". The base theme stays in effect. (Cobalt Mono diagnosis receipt)
traces.ui_projection: Diagnosis panel with line/key/message, fallback-active banner, phase strip

traces.ui_command_id: cmd.theme.preview (ephemeral) + cmd.theme.apply (persistent) - reuse-flag against existing cmd.theme.*
traces.validation_permission: Preview: none (ephemeral, per-window). Apply: settings write
traces.mutation_or_operation: Preview: data-theme attribute swap on enter/focus, restore on leave/blur/rebuild. Apply: PMShell.applyView({theme}) + persist through the shell's own storage key; glass-locked rows re-resolve live
traces.receipt: Apply theme - applied live, no restart, persisted for this concept
traces.ui_projection: The whole shell recolors during hover/focus; Active chip moves on apply; glass rows unlock/lock live

traces.mutation_or_operation: Row toggle mutates general.desktop.minimize-to-tray / close-to-tray (same rows in console strip and workspace)
traces.receipt: statusbar confirmation; tray menu preview stays a labeled static rendering
traces.ui_projection: Row value chip + console summary line

traces.canonical_owner: Plans/FinalGUISpec.md (writing & spelling) - shared with PMSpell's composer context menu
traces.validation_permission: Non-empty word; scope personal or project
traces.mutation_or_operation: Append to store key spell.personal / spell.project - the SAME keys PMSpell persists from the Assistant composer, so both paths converge
traces.receipt: Add to personal dictionary - "<word>" will no longer be flagged
traces.ui_projection: New chip on the dictionary board; composer stops underlining it

traces.validation_permission: The handoff requires an explicit activation inside the overlay; Teacher never submits or pre-fills secrets
traces.mutation_or_operation: PMState.trigger('teacher-explain','teach.slack-setup') opens the overlay; step 1 highlights the real dest.slack card; step 2's action closes the overlay and opens the REAL add-destination form with kind slack and the workspace field focused
traces.receipt: none for the explanation itself; the downstream add flow carries its own receipt
traces.ui_projection: Step overlay with highlight outline, then the live add form (one-shot focus, nothing pre-submitted)
traces.usage_attribution: none (Teacher overlay is local; a provider-backed Teacher chat would attribute to the Assistant role)
